City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation for the 19th Annual Encinitas Chamber of Commerce Oktoberfest
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 8/20/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-09-10 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-09-10 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Introduction of Ordinance 2014-10 amending Encinitas Municipal Code Sections 2.12.060 and 2.12.070 relating to Conflict of Interest filers. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Introduce Ordinance 2014-10 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Sections 2.12.060 and 2.12.070 regarding Conflict of Interest filers."
2014-09-10 Item 8C - Amendments to Conflict of Interest Code
8D.
Review, consideration and approval of FY2013-14 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report for the Community Development Block Grant and HOME Investment Partnership programs. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Approve the report and authorize submission to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development.
2014-09-10 Item 8D - FY2013-14 Consolidated Annual Performance Review and Evaluation Report CDBG
8E.
Adoption of Ordinance 2014-08 adding Chapter 11.26 "Single-Use Disposable Bag Reduction" to the Encinitas Municipal Code. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Adopt Ordinance 2014-08 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Chapter 11.26 "Single-Use Disposable Bag Reduction" to the Encinitas Municipal Code Prohibiting Retail Establishments from Providing Single-Use Carryout Bags and Regulating the Distribution of Paper Carryout Bags."
2014-09-10 Item 8E - Single-Use Disposable Bag Reduction Ordinance
8F.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters for the Mayor's signature.
2014-09-10 Item 8F - Legislative Position Letters
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.

10A.

Council to consider taking an official position on Measure F entitled "Shall the ordinance amending the Encinitas Municipal Code to authorize and regulate medical marijuana dispensaries in the City of Encinitas be adopted?" Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood

2014-09-10 Item 10B - Consideration of Council Position on Measure F

12A.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
